name: kexec-tools
notes: Plain autotools; builds against the host toolchain.

name: seabios
notes: Needs iasl for the ACPI tables.

name: optiboot
notes: Needs avr-gcc; not in the default image.

name: petitboot
notes: autotools; some platform backends need extra libraries.

name: syslinux
notes: Does not build with modern binutils: com32/elflink/ldlinux fails to link (verified on binutils 2.42/gcc 13). Needs distro patches or an older toolchain before CodeQL can watch a build.

name: u-boot
notes: The sandbox target builds on the host with no cross toolchain.

name: grub
notes: bootstrap pulls gnulib; needs network on first run.

name: opensbi
notes: Needs a riscv64 cross toolchain; not in the default image.

name: trusted-firmware-m
notes: Needs cmake and an arm-none-eabi toolchain.

name: mcuboot
notes: The simulator target avoids a cross toolchain.

name: coreboot
notes: Builds its own cross toolchain; slow (tens of minutes).

name: edk2
build: make -C BaseTools && . edksetup.sh && build -a X64 -t GCC5 -p MdeModulePkg/MdeModulePkg.dsc
notes: Needs submodules initialised inside edk2 itself.

name: petitboot
notes: autotools; the ncurses UI needs extra libraries, so disable it.
